name: v0.0.77
body:
## What's Changed
* A `/` write root (Linux) or read root (macOS) no longer switches off the denies beneath it by @ronleizrowice-ant in https://github.com/anthropics/sandbox-runtime/pull/533
* perf: resolve the global npm root off the event loop by @sosukesuzuki in https://github.com/anthropics/sandbox-runtime/pull/550
* linux: a re-applied read-deny tmpfs restores read-only, so the write deny above it wins by @ronleizrowice-ant in https://github.com/anthropics/sandbox-runtime/pull/537
* linux: pass an over-long bwrap profile through --args by @ronleizrowice-ant in https://github.com/anthropics/sandbox-runtime/pull/504
* macos: deny a path the library computed as a literal, not a pattern by @ronleizrowice-ant in https://github.com/anthropics/sandbox-runtime/pull/542
* linux: keep a masked file masked when it is a write path or listed through a symlinked directory by @ronleizrowice-ant in https://github.com/anthropics/sandbox-runtime/pull/554
* Linux: pin ancestor directories of deny binds against rename by @ronleizrowice-ant in https://github.com/anthropics/sandbox-runtime/pull/514
* linux: a read deny or credential mask on a symlinked allowRead target wins over the carve-out by @ronleizrowice-ant in https://github.com/anthropics/sandbox-runtime/pull/555
* config: reject a deny glob written with a trailing separator by @ronleizrowice-ant in https://github.com/anthropics/sandbox-runtime/pull/536
* linux: collapse read-deny globs to directories, and mount denies where paths resolve by @ronleizrowice-ant in https://github.com/anthropics/sandbox-runtime/pull/503
* linux: throw a typed error when the bubblewrap profile cannot be run by @ronleizrowice-ant in https://github.com/anthropics/sandbox-runtime/pull/553
* violations: sanitize forged attribution keys, and give the Linux monitor bwrap's write rules by @ronleizrowice-ant in https://github.com/anthropics/sandbox-runtime/pull/535
* linux: refuse at start-up when root lacks CAP_SETFCAP, and correct the capability docs by @ronleizrowice-ant in https://github.com/anthropics/sandbox-runtime/pull/534
* fix(build): drop the duplicate normalizePathForSandbox import in sandbox-manager by @dylan-conway in https://github.com/anthropics/sandbox-runtime/pull/562
* linux: remove the deny mount point a killed process left on the host by @ronleizrowice-ant in https://github.com/anthropics/sandbox-runtime/pull/524
* Default write paths obey a read deny, and interior path spellings are canonicalised by @ronleizrowice-ant in https://github.com/anthropics/sandbox-runtime/pull/506
* cli: refuse an unusable control fd or settings file, and keep the fd out of the sandbox by @ronleizrowice-ant in https://github.com/anthropics/sandbox-runtime/pull/539
* test(windows): fix five sources of failures in the Windows CI steps by @dylan-conway in https://github.com/anthropics/sandbox-runtime/pull/563
* linux: walk a read-deny glob's directories once each, not once per name by @dylan-conway in https://github.com/anthropics/sandbox-runtime/pull/564
* ci: run on Bun 1.4.2, and fix two tests it and a Linux timeout exposed by @dylan-conway in https://github.com/anthropics/sandbox-runtime/pull/565
* perf(proxy): keep the TLS-terminate upstream connection alive per client connection by @dylan-conway in https://github.com/anthropics/sandbox-runtime/pull/561


**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/anthropics/sandbox-runtime/compare/v0.0.76...v0.0.77
